existing_prospective_evidence.interpretation: Weeks 1-3 are early descriptive evidence under frozen upstream studies and cannot authorize a TE model change.

legacy_production_lineage_diagnostic.interpretation: Legacy lineage drift is diagnostic only; elevated TE drift is a broad-cohort follow-up signal, not deployment authority.

next_step_if_green: Review A20 findings. If no material TE calibration concern is established, freeze no-change and continue with B1 DL Structural Integrity Audit V1. If a material concern remains, preregister a broad-cohort TE calibration study before fitting or validation.

benchmark_offense_forward.both_sources: 50% FantasyPros Trade-Desk-normalized points + 50% Sleeper league-scored points

scientific_limits: This audit can identify mechanical compression, discontinuities, age sensitivity, coverage gaps, and lineage instability.
It cannot establish the true market price of TE scarcity.
It cannot infer that a specific named TE is too high or too low.
Production V2 Phase 1 is transparent but uncalibrated.
Weeks 1-3 realized outcomes are too early under frozen prospective protocols to select or deploy a TE model change.
No new TE weight, age curve, production transform, youth premium, or player-specific adjustment is fit here.
